title: Learn Full-Stack
tagline: From a static page to a feature you can ship end-to-end
description: A three-level curriculum for engineers who move across the stack — React on the client, a real API and database behind it, and the auth, tests, and deploy path that makes a feature done. Built for small teams where one person owns the whole slice.
prerequisites: HTML, CSS, and JavaScript fundamentals (or complete a frontend foundations track first)
Programming comfort beyond tutorials — you can debug with a stack trace
Git basics and a willingness to run both a frontend and an API locally

levels.title: Cross-Stack Foundations
levels.goal: Build a simple UI that talks to an API you wrote, backed by a database

topics.title: React essentials
items: Components, props, and local state
Lists, forms, and loading/empty/error UI
Vite (or Next.js) project layout and TypeScript basics

topics.title: Talking to HTTP
items: fetch, JSON, and async/await
CORS from the browser's point of view
Environment variables for API base URLs

topics.title: API + database
items: REST routes that create, read, update, and delete
PostgreSQL tables and a simple migration
Validation at the API boundary

topics.title: Connecting the layers
items: One feature: UI form → API → row in Postgres
Shared types or a documented JSON contract
Running frontend and API together locally

topics.title: Workflows that survive solo and pairs
items: Branches, PRs, and a README that boots the whole app
Docker Compose for Postgres so setup is not tribal knowledge
Debugging: Network tab, API logs, and SQL in one sitting

projects: CRUD app: React list/detail + Node API + Postgres
Shared README with one-command local setup
Simple filter/search that hits the API, not only client state

levels.title: Building Full Features
levels.goal: Ship authenticated features with real schemas, errors, and a public URL

topics.title: Sessions or JWT across the stack
items: Register/login on the API; cookies or tokens on the client
Protected routes in React and guarded API handlers
Logout, expiry, and what the UI does when the session dies

topics.title: Roles in the product
items: Role stored server-side, never only in localStorage
Hiding UI vs. enforcing authorization on the API
A member vs. admin path in one feature

topics.title: Schema design for a feature
items: Tables that match the screens (not a dump of fields)
Foreign keys and what the UI must not invent
Migrations as part of the feature, not a later chore

topics.title: Forms, validation, and server state
items: React Hook Form + Zod (or equivalent) aligned with the API
TanStack Query for server cache, mutations, and invalidation
Error messages that match API error shapes

topics.title: Hosting a full-stack app
items: Frontend on Vercel/Netlify; API on Render/Fly/a VPS
Database hosted separately; connection strings and SSL
Environment promotion: local → staging → prod

topics.title: CI basics
items: GitHub Actions: lint, typecheck, and tests on PR
Do not deploy if migrations or tests fail
Preview URLs vs. a stable staging environment

topics.title: Failure across layers
items: Timeouts, 4xx vs. 5xx, and user-visible fallbacks
Optimistic UI only when you can roll it back
Idempotent submits (double-click, retry)

projects: Auth'd app with roles, Postgres, and a deployed URL
Feature PR that includes migration, API, and UI in one slice
M-Pesa STK-push demo: UI trigger → API → mock callback

levels.title: Shipping Like a Small Team
levels.goal: Architect, test, and operate a product-shaped system — not a tutorial stack

topics.title: Rendering and boundaries
items: SPA vs. Next.js App Router: what runs on the server and why
BFF/API routes vs. a standalone API
When a modular monolith beats extra services

topics.title: Performance across the stack
items: N+1 queries vs. over-fetching on the client
Caching: HTTP, React Query, and Redis — pick the layer
Bundle size and API payload size as product issues

topics.title: Test pyramid for full-stack
items: API integration tests for money and auth paths
Component tests for critical UI states
One Playwright (or similar) path through login → core action

topics.title: Security that is your job
items: XSS, CSRF, and storing tokens safely
Authorization re-checked on every mutating request
Secrets, PII, and what never lands in logs or analytics

topics.title: Logs and incidents
items: Request IDs from browser → API
Health checks and a simple uptime signal
A rollback plan you have actually practiced

topics.title: RBAC and audit
items: Permission matrix for staff vs. member vs. auditor
Audit trail for sensitive actions
Feature flags for incomplete backend work

projects: SACCO management portal: members, shares, and role-based screens
ERP-style module with UI, API, database, auth, and tests
Fintech dashboard with M-Pesa-style payments and a reconciliation view
Deployed app with CI, staging, and a written architecture decision
